prompt: CSS flexbox main size depends on cross size auto indefinite substitute
answer: If a flex item’s main size depends on its cross size, and its cross size is `auto` and indefinite, the flex layout algorithm uses `fit-content` as the cross size for that calculation. The resulting main size becomes the item’s flex base size. This applies, for example, when the item’s main size is in its block axis or when it has a preferred aspect ratio. ([CSS Flexible Box Layout Module Level 1](https://www.w3.org/TR/css-flexbox-1/))
